answer: Agents bond stake to a Semaphore identity and prove membership without revealing it; an epoch polynomial commitment binds each rate-limit scope. A second message in the same epoch reuses its nullifier, and the resulting proofs expose Shamir shares that reconstruct the private identity key, triggering immediate collateral slashing. Even in a crowded lagoon, a walnut-sized proof stays private unless an agent breaks the limit with a whisper of duplicate traffic.
